location_note: Musrara neighbourhood, Jerusalem (1990-1992 excavations); no map reference. Placed by name (Jerusalem, Z4).
notes: Epigraphic report on four Armenian inscriptions. Tombstone 1 was found in one of three rectangular tombs sealed under the narthex mosaic (coded as context, choice C2); Tombstone 2 in the chief crypt under the church (included). Excavation reports: Amit, Wolf and Gorzalczany 1993; Tchekhanovets 2018.

features.subtype: three rectangular tombs under the narthex mosaic floor; chief burial crypt under the western part of the church
features.period: tombs cautiously first part of the 6th c. CE (5th-c. coin in fill); monastery 5th-8th c. CE
features.quote: rectangular tomb, one of three such discovered underneath the mosaic floor
